card.name: Shake or stand in reconstitution steps
card.fires_on: The verbs shake, stand and cool in preparation instructions, mostly right after water is added to a powder or vial. Also fires on a few waiting-time words in the same steps.

modes.label: Shake instruction
modes.description: The verb shake starting or continuing a step after adding liquid to a vial or bottle.
modes.example: Add 34 mL of water in two portions.<< Shake>> well after each addition

modes.label: Stand or cool
modes.description: Verbs for letting a solution rest or cool before the next step.
modes.example: Shake to dissolve and let<< stand>> until clear.

card.plain: It marks the 'shake the vial' or 'let it stand' step in mixing instructions.
